Edge Case: Submit the form with the goal name left blank
Expected Behavior: Submission is blocked; "Give your goal a name." is shown under the Name field.

Edge Case: Enter only spaces as the goal name
Expected Behavior: Treated as empty after trimming; the same "Give your goal a name." error is shown and submission is blocked.

Edge Case: Enter a name with leading/trailing spaces (e.g. "  Dubai Trip  ")
Expected Behavior: Name is trimmed before saving; "Dubai Trip" is shown with no extra spaces on the Plan and Goal screens.

Edge Case: Submit the form with the amount field left blank
Expected Behavior: Submission is blocked; "Enter an amount greater than ₹0." is shown.

Edge Case: Enter "0" as the target amount
Expected Behavior: Rejected as not greater than ₹0; the same amount error is shown.

Edge Case: Type letters, symbols, or a decimal point into the amount field (e.g. "10a.5b")
Expected Behavior: Non-numeric characters are silently discarded as they are typed, leaving only digits (e.g. "105"); decimal amounts are not supported.

Edge Case: Enter an amount with leading zeros (e.g. "00500")
Expected Behavior: Interpreted as 500; plan and progress figures calculate correctly.

Edge Case: Enter an extremely large amount (15+ digits)
Expected Behavior: Value is accepted with no upper bound and may lose numeric precision or display an unwieldy currency figure on later screens.

Edge Case: Leave both date fields at their defaults (today and today + 30 days) and submit
Expected Behavior: Form submits successfully and produces a 30-day plan.

Edge Case: Set the target date equal to the start date
Expected Behavior: Blocked; "Target date must be after your start date." is shown.

Edge Case: Pick a target date first, then move the start date to on/after that target date
Expected Behavior: Submission stays blocked with the dates error until the target date is corrected manually - it is not auto-adjusted when the start date changes.

Edge Case: Set the start date to a date in the past
Expected Behavior: Allowed; the plan is calculated using the longer elapsed period from the past start date to the target date.

Edge Case: Set the target date to exactly one day after the start date (minimum allowed gap)
Expected Behavior: Passes validation; Plan screen shows a 1-day / 1-week / 1-month plan for the full amount.

Edge Case: Leave name, amount, and dates all invalid at once and submit
Expected Behavior: All relevant field errors display together; nothing is saved and the user remains on the form.

Edge Case: Reach the Plan screen with no goal data set (e.g. app reload while on this screen)
Expected Behavior: User is automatically redirected to the Home screen instead of seeing a broken plan.

Edge Case: Build a plan for a goal due the very next day
Expected Behavior: Daily pace shows 1 contribution of the full amount; monthly pace also shows the full amount due "in 1 month" even though only 1 day remains, since the plan enforces a 1-month minimum.

Edge Case: Build a plan spanning several years
Expected Behavior: Daily/weekly/monthly contribution counts scale up correctly and remain readable.

Edge Case: Target amount that does not divide evenly across the chosen period
Expected Behavior: Each pace amount is rounded up to the nearest rupee, so the sum of all scheduled contributions can slightly exceed the target amount rather than fall short.

Edge Case: Start date on the 31st of a month with a target date in a shorter following month (e.g. 31 Jan to 28 Feb)
Expected Behavior: Monthly count accounts for the target day not yet being "reached" in the cycle, reducing the month count by one versus a naive calendar subtraction.

Edge Case: Tap Start Goal without selecting a daily/weekly/monthly pace
Expected Behavior: Button remains disabled and does not respond to taps.

Edge Case: Select one pace card, then tap a different one before confirming
Expected Behavior: Only the most recently selected card stays checked; that pace is the one used when Start Goal is tapped.

Edge Case: Reach the Goal screen without having started a goal (e.g. app reload, or navigating back after a reset)
Expected Behavior: User is automatically redirected to the Home screen.

Edge Case: Tap Confirm with the contribution amount left blank
Expected Behavior: "Enter an amount greater than ₹0." error is shown; no contribution is recorded.

Edge Case: Enter "0" as the contribution amount
Expected Behavior: Rejected by the same greater-than-₹0 check; no contribution is recorded.

Edge Case: Type non-numeric characters into the contribution amount field
Expected Behavior: Non-digit characters are silently discarded as they are typed.

Edge Case: Add a contribution that exactly equals the remaining amount
Expected Behavior: Saved amount reaches the target exactly; progress and all four milestones show 100% unlocked, and the completion card (trophy icon, "Goal achieved" heading, congratulatory message, Share Your Win) replaces the header instead of a milestone celebration banner.

Edge Case: Add a contribution larger than the remaining amount (overshoot)
Expected Behavior: Progress, milestone unlock states, and the completion card all treat this as exactly 100% - no milestone or progress value ever exceeds 100%, even though the displayed "Saved" amount itself is not capped and can exceed the goal amount.

Edge Case: Open the contribution form, type a value, then tap Cancel
Expected Behavior: Form closes without saving; reopening Add Contribution starts blank with no leftover value or error.

Edge Case: Add several contributions one after another
Expected Behavior: Each confirmed contribution adds to the running saved total; the progress bar, percentage, milestone markers/list, and motivational message all update after every confirmation, with a celebration banner appearing only the first time a new milestone is crossed.

Edge Case: Goal reaches 100% complete
Expected Behavior: Add Contribution button and the regular name/saved-amount header are both hidden, replaced by the goal completion card; no further contributions are possible from the UI.

Edge Case: Create a new goal while a previous goal already has saved progress
Expected Behavior: Starting a new goal fully resets pace, contribution amount, saved amount, started status, and gamification state (highestMilestoneSeen back to 0, no pending celebration) - prior progress and unlocked milestones are discarded, not carried over.

Edge Case: Navigate back from Goal to Plan, then tap Start Goal again
Expected Behavior: A new Goal screen is pushed on top of the previous one, so the back stack accumulates duplicate Plan/Goal entries rather than reusing the existing screen.

Edge Case: Reload the app or trigger a live/dev refresh mid-flow
Expected Behavior: All goal data - including milestone/celebration state - is held in memory only with no persistence; state resets to empty and the active screen's guard redirects back to Home.

Edge Case: Add a contribution that brings saved amount to exactly 25% / 50% / 75% of the target
Expected Behavior: That milestone immediately shows as completed (green checkmark marker on the progress track and in the Milestones list), and a one-time "Milestone unlocked" celebration banner names it (e.g. "Halfway There").

Edge Case: A single contribution moves progress from below 25% to above 75% (e.g. 10% -> 80%)
Expected Behavior: 25%, 50%, and 75% all show unlocked in the milestone track/list, but only ONE celebration banner appears - for the highest newly crossed milestone (Almost There / 75%) - not three sequential popups.

Edge Case: A single contribution moves progress directly from below 25% to 100% (e.g. 10% -> 100%)
Expected Behavior: All four milestones show unlocked, but no milestone celebration banner appears; the goal completion card is shown instead as the single celebratory moment, taking priority over a 100% "Goal Crushed" toast.

Edge Case: After a milestone's celebration banner has been shown (auto-dismissed after ~2.8s or tapped away), add another contribution that keeps progress within the same unlocked range (e.g. already past 50%, contributing further without reaching 75%)
Expected Behavior: No celebration banner reappears for the already-unlocked milestone; `highestMilestoneSeen` in the store prevents it from firing again for the life of this goal.

Edge Case: View a freshly started goal with ₹0 saved
Expected Behavior: All four milestones show as locked/upcoming; the first (Getting Started) is highlighted as the current/next target with the rupee amount needed to unlock it. No milestone shows as unlocked.

Edge Case: View the goal screen at 0%, just above 0%, and at/after each milestone boundary
Expected Behavior: The motivational message updates to match the corresponding band ("Your journey starts with the first contribution." at 0%, "Great start" just above 0%, "First milestone unlocked" at/after 25%, "Halfway there" at/after 50%, "You're in the final stretch" at/after 75%); the message line is not shown once the goal is complete - the completion card's own copy replaces it.

Edge Case: Reach 100% complete
Expected Behavior: The header is replaced by a completion card showing a trophy icon, "Goal achieved" heading, the goal name, the target amount, "100% complete", a short congratulatory message, and a "Share Your Win" button; the milestone track/list and the existing goal-details card (amount/saved/remaining/date/plan) remain visible below it.

Edge Case: Tap "Share Your Win" on a completed goal and either send or dismiss the native share sheet
Expected Behavior: The share sheet opens with a message that includes the goal name and target amount; dismissing it without sharing produces no error and leaves the completion card unchanged.

Edge Case: The Share API rejects (e.g. no share target available on the current platform)
Expected Behavior: The failure is caught silently by the completion card; the app does not crash and no error is surfaced to the user.

Edge Case: View the goal screen before the goal reaches 100%
Expected Behavior: No Share / "Share Your Win" action is present anywhere on screen - it only appears on the completion card.

Edge Case: Complete a goal (or unlock some milestones), then create a new goal from Home
Expected Behavior: The new goal's milestone track/list show all four milestones locked again with no celebration banner carried over from the previous goal.
